archetypes.name: dyn-checks-loop
archetypes.rationale: Review the new repair-loop state machine and KV/exit mapping.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/checks.py and python/test_checks.py. Verify dispatch-first no-changes handling re-dispatches with a fresh redacted log without skipping the required re-check. Check that NEXT_ACTION, tail paths, ledger KVs, and validation failures match the documented orchestrator contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-orchestrator-prose
archetypes.rationale: Review the collapsed SKILL prose and reference integration.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on skills/implement/SKILL.md and skills/implement/references/checks-repair-loop.md. Verify each checks failure site still preserves anti-halt local guidance while delegating all repair-loop behavior to the reference. Pay special attention to Step 5 MAV/coder site splitting and post-main-agent re-entry instructions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
